summary: Round-3 finding is closed: the false abort clause is gone from both sites, supervisar_ingesta is byte-identical to efc1778, and the deletion introduced nothing new.
notes: contract-check ok=true; violations: none; not_checked: forbid.behaviors. 10 files, +1159/-21 = 1180 lines against a max_diff_lines of 1500, one insertion fewer than round 3 because the deletion is net -1.

acceptance-coverage status=pass; AC-1..AC-6 all covered; gaps: none; the two legacy_untracked entries remain the regression and lint criteria, covered by cargo test --workspace and the clippy/fmt commands.

ROUND-3 FINDING CLOSED. Commit 1dde430 removes the clause 'cubre el aborto de la tarea que no viene del apagado' from both sites named in the round-3 fix_task: the supervisar_ingesta doc comment in crates/hexcell/src/admin.rs and the HEX-063 entry in docs/STATUS.md (rank 4). git diff 92fa8a3..1dde430 --stat is exactly those two files, 5 and 2 lines, +3/-4.

RESIDUAL SCAN CLEAN. A case-insensitive sweep of the whole worktree (excluding .git and target) for 'cubre el aborto', 'aborto de tarea', 'ajeno al apagado' and 'dos razones' returns nothing. docs/bitacora-de-descartes.md carries no restatement of the guard's scope (no hit for vigilante/JoinError/is_cancelled), 07-trace.json carries none either, and docs/STATUS.md mentions the vigilante exactly once. The only surviving copies are immutable history: the 92fa8a3 commit body and the round-3 fix_task text, both correctly left alone.

SUPERVISAR_INGESTA UNCHANGED, verified twice. The function body extracted at efc1778, 92fa8a3 and 1dde430 hashes identically (md5 9b1e119d44091ec4236207a2c87f6fa9, 12 lines each); and admin.rs with every /// line stripped hashes identically at all three commits (9beabaea72ea5ae0bd83eaef95261257), so no non-doc byte moved anywhere in the file, not just in the function. git diff efc1778..1dde430 -- crates/ contains zero non-/// changed lines.

NOTHING NEW INTRODUCED. Both edited sentences are grammatical and self-contained after the deletion: admin.rs now reads 'Se conserva de todos modos por una razon que basta sola: evita que el hueco reaparezca en silencio si algun dia el perfil de release vuelve a desenrollar', STATUS.md 'se conserva porque impide que el hueco reaparezca en silencio si el perfil de release volviera a desenrollar'. No dangling 'por dos razones' enumeration, no orphaned connective, no reference to a removed clause.

NOT AN UNDERSTATEMENT. Both sites still state that the panic branch is reachable under panic = "unwind", the development and test profile, before giving the retained reason, so the guard is not described as dead code. The claim is if anything conservative: crates/hexcell/tests/admin_http.rs:406-415 actively exercises that branch, spawning a panicking task, awaiting supervisar_ingesta and asserting the phase is terminal and carries MOTIVO_DE_TERMINACION_ANORMAL. The retained reason is also exhaustive, since tokio's JoinError has only Cancelled and Panic and the Cancelled arm is deliberately discarded, so no true justification was lost with the false one.

PROFILE CLAIM RE-VERIFIED against the tree, not against the earlier round: Cargo.toml:92 sets panic = "abort" under [profile.release] only, with no other profile overriding it, so the doc's parenthetical '(raiz Cargo.toml)' is accurate.

COMMIT BODY OF 1dde430 CHECKED. It states the retraction honestly and correctly: two JoinError variants, JoinHandle::abort() producing Cancelled, the handle moved into supervisar_ingesta and retained nowhere, the contradiction with the following doc paragraph, and the explicit note that supervisar_ingesta is untouched. It contains no Co-Authored-By, no AI attribution and no 'Generated with' string, and it is a conventional docs(hexcell): commit in Spanish. efc1778 and 92fa8a3 were correctly not rewritten.

SETTLED MATTERS RECONFIRMED UNCHANGED, not reopened: the withheld ADR (docs/adr/** is outside the contract's touch list, judged acceptable in round 3), the three redundant-but-harmless assertions in admin_http.rs judged non-findings in round 2, and the over-hard self-criticism in the 92fa8a3 commit body. 1dde430 touches none of them.

VALIDATION FRESHNESS, observation only, not a finding: 05-validation.json still records its 8/8 exit-0 run against 92fa8a3 and was not re-stamped for 1dde430. The delta is doc-comment lines only, so no command outcome can change, and the human re-ran cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace and cargo test -p hexcell --test admin_http (11 passed) on 1dde430, all exit 0. The working tree is clean and the branch is ai/HEX-063-new-spec at 1dde430.
